name: Wenatchee River (Lake Wenatchee – Tumwater)
blurb: Gentle braided river out of Lake Wenatchee through Plain — easy floating with mountain views.

sections.notes: Isolated logjams. The Plain take-out is concrete stairs ~20 ft below the Chumstick Hwy bridge, river right — hard to spot at high water. Strong winds are common (AW). Lake Wenatchee State Park: Discover Pass required plus a $7/day Watercraft Launch Fee; launch hours summer 6:30 a.m.-dusk, winter 8 a.m.-dusk (parks.wa.gov). Plain take-out fee status not confirmed.
